Add ACMR as an underfollowed wet-processing and wafer-level/advanced-packaging equipment candidate, with explicit need to verify advanced-packaging revenue mix and geographic/geopolitical risk.
Advanced packaging bottlenecks should be decomposed into at least four tool/material subnodes: inspection/metrology, bonding, wet process/plating/cleaning, and substrate/material handling.

This pass did not cover substrate makers, underfill/TIM materials, temporary bond/debond specialists, organic interposer suppliers, or handler/test-socket vendors; run a separate Layer 1B expansion for those subnodes.

node: Advanced packaging capacity, substrates, inspection, and process equipment
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the advanced packaging/substrate/tools node found three US-listed, mid-cap discovery-lane candidates with plausible direct exposure to AI/HBM/chiplet packaging bottlenecks: Camtek for inspection/metrology, Kulicke & Soffa for thermo-compression and heterogeneous-integration bonding, and ACM Research for wet-processing/electroplating/advanced-packaging equipment. These are not buy/sell recommendations; they are research candidates for later evidence grading and falsification.
